gloss: full command; making full use of

definitions.gloss: full command; making full use of; wielding freely
definitions.explanation: Using a skill, tool, language, or ability to its full extent with mastery and ease.

examples.japanese: {英語|えいご}を{駆使|くし}して{交渉|こうしょう}した。
examples.english: I used my full command of English to negotiate.

examples.japanese: {最新|さいしん}の{技術|ぎじゅつ}を{駆使|くし}した{製品|せいひん}だ。
examples.english: It's a product that makes full use of the latest technology.

examples.japanese: あらゆる{人脈|じんみゃく}と{知識|ちしき}を{駆使|くし}して、{困難|こんなん}なプロジェクトを{成功|せいこう}させた。
examples.english: They used all their connections and knowledge to make the difficult project a success.

notes:
Implies skilled, confident use rather than basic use. Always positive — conveys mastery rather than mere utilization.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- ～を{駆使|くし}する (make full use of ~)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {語学力|ごがくりょく}を{駆使|くし}する (make full use of language skills)
- {技術|ぎじゅつ}を{駆使|くし}する (make full use of technology)
- {知識|ちしき}を{駆使|くし}する (make full use of knowledge)
- あらゆる{手段|しゅだん}を{駆使|くし}する (use every means available)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {使|つか}う is the neutral word for "use"
- {活用|かつよう}する means to make practical use of
- {駆使|くし}する implies mastery and full exploitation of one's abilities
